sentences.text: The scheme SCTUKBOCWWB stands for the Scheme for Construction Workers under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
It was launched to provide financial assistance and welfare benefits to construction workers in India.
The main objective is to improve the living conditions of construction workers and their families.
The scheme offers various benefits including financial assistance for medical treatment, education, and housing.
It also provides support for skill development and training programs.
Eligibility for the scheme includes being a registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Act 1996.
Applicants must be at least 18 years old and should not exceed the age limit set by the respective state government.
The application process typically involves submitting a registration form along with necessary documents to the local Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board office.
The timeline for processing applications may vary by state but is generally completed within a few weeks.
The implementing authorities are the respective state Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Boards.
Additional details may include specific benefits that vary by state and the requirement for regular renewal of registration.
